description.value: Black & Blue is a Kobe-beef certified upscale steakhouse operated by the Glowbal Restaurant Group in downtown Vancouver. The venue includes a ground-floor dining room and The Roof, described as Vancouver's largest rooftop dining destination, featuring a Josper wood-coal grill. Private dining rooms and group event booking are available, making it a destination for special occasions rather than a casual cyclist stop.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 82m; stands (5 spaces) at 94m. Total: 8 spaces.
